overall: Final draft is clean: all 100 pool tokens covered, checker ok_rate 1.0 (323/323), and the six exclusive calls (hentai and the porn/pornography forms) are correct; multi calls are all defensible. Items are consistently outside the concept: sexual-vocabulary tokens are handled through medicine, biology, classical myth, art history, grammar, older word senses and LGBT/feminist history, and none gives an advantage to knowledge of pornography, its industry or its law; topics stay at encyclopedic/school level. I found no factual errors or double-correct options. The only clear violations are seven items where the token sits in an empty, removable aside ("(DSM-5)", "a romantic holiday", "an illegal practice", "by feminists worldwide", "such as tyres and condoms", "the romantic Moonlight Sonata") so the token is not needed; these are dropped. Several tokens remain under 4 items (e.g. Femin, Sexual, obscene, orgas, orgasm, ORN at 1 item), as the writer documented; acceptable given the token constraints. Minor style weaknesses (Cinecittà question echoing Rome/Italy, two Playboy items on the same play) were left as keep.
